pairs.question: Quid vobis de homine isto videtur, qui talia perpetravit?
pairs.answer: Esse eum dignum multis suppliciis excruciatum interire.
pairs.derivation: Grimuald asks his attendants their judgment of the chamberlain who helped Perctarit escape; the relative clause 'qui talia perpetravit' is kept so 'homine isto' has a referent. The framing 'Tunc rex a circumstantibus requisivit dicens' is dropped as speech-tag. The answer is the reported reply ('Tunc omnes una voce responderunt, esse eum dignum...'); the speech-tag 'Tunc omnes una voce responderunt' is dropped, leaving the verbatim accusative-and-infinitive answer, ending at the full stop before 'At rex'.
